weakness_class: F115 Security controls bypass or absence
trigger: HTTP request to any @RateLimiter-annotated method, with an attacker-controlled X-Tenant-Id header
exploit_path: Caller rotates/forges X-Tenant-Id per request; each value creates a fresh RateLimiter bucket, so the per-name limit (e.g. login throttling) is never hit and the control is bypassed
notes: Mirrors reference client vuln that keyed a rate limiter on the spoofable X-Forwarded-For header; micronaut-http is a compileOnly dep of the module
